name: Cala (Spain)
description: A blue hoist stripe and a fly of five horizontal stripes of yellow, white, yellow, white and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cala (a castle, a fish and a jug on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Cala; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: five horizontal stripes at the fly
Cala arms — castle, fish and jug on blue
cap of the crown of the arms
